[[Taag Relicbinder]] is a [[Charr]] [[boss]]. His primary focus seems to be on [[Smiting Prayers]], though he will heal himself and others if need be, which makes him a rather tough boss to beat for low-level characters.

==Locations==
* [[Ascalon]]
** {{NPC location|The Breach}} (level 7)
** {{NPC location|Flame Temple Corridor}} (during [[Special Ops: Flame Temple Corridor]]) (level 24)

==Skills==
'''Prophecies'''
* {{skill icon|Bane Signet}}
* {{skill icon|Banish}}
* {{skill icon|Heal Area}}
* {{skill icon|Infuse Health}}

'''Eye of the North''' ([[Special Ops: Flame Temple Corridor]])
* {{skill icon|Chorus of Restoration}}
* {{skill icon|Life Sheath}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Mend Condition}}
* {{skill icon|Protective Spirit}}
* {{skill icon|Reversal of Fortune}}

*[[Charr Carving]]
*[[Charr Hide]]
*[[Shaman Garb]]

==Notes==
*In the Breach, this boss shares 4 possible spawn points with 5 other bosses: [[Gorgaan Hatemonger]], [[Drim Cindershot]], [[Cess Corpselighter]], [[Mirash Dreambreaker]], and [[Suurg the Hateful]].
